import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        int h, w;
        long[] a;

        Matrix(int n) {
            h = n;
            w = n;
            a = new long[n * n];
        }

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            h = n;
            w = m;
            a = new long[n * m];
        }

        Matrix(int n, int m, long[] arr) {
            h = n;
            w = m;
            a = arr.clone();
        }

        long get(int r, int c) {
            return a[r * w + c];
        }

        void set(int r, int c, long val) {
            a[r * w + c] = val % MOD;
        }

        void add(Matrix m) {
            if (h != m.h || w != m.w) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix dimensions mismatch for addition");
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                a[i] = (a[i] + m.a[i]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        void subtract(Matrix m) {
            if (h != m.h || w != m.w) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix dimensions mismatch for subtraction");
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                a[i] = (a[i] - m.a[i]) % MOD;
                if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += MOD;
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix m) {
            if (w != m.h) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix dimensions mismatch for multiplication");
            Matrix res = new Matrix(h, m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.w; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < w; k++) {
                        sum = (sum + get(i, k) * m.get(k, j)) % MOD;
                    }
                    res.set(i, j, sum);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        void multiplyInPlace(Matrix m) {
            if (w != m.h) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix dimensions mismatch for multiplication");
            Matrix res = multiply(m);
            this.h = res.h;
            this.w = res.w;
            this.a = res.a;
        }

        static Matrix unit(int n) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                m.set(i, i, 1);
            }
            return m;
        }

        static Matrix matpow(Matrix a, long exp) {
            if (a.h != a.w) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix must be square for exponentiation");
            Matrix res = Matrix.unit(a.h);
            Matrix base = a;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[] a = new Matrix[65];

    static Matrix calc(int i, int k) {
        return Matrix.matpow(a[i + k], k - i).multiply(Matrix.matpow(a[i], i));
    }

    static long solve(long n, long k) {
        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp > 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            ++cnt;
        }
        int size = (int) cnt + 5;
        Matrix[] b = new Matrix[size];
        Matrix[] c = new Matrix[size];

        b[0] = a[(int) (k - 1)];
        c[0] = Matrix.matpow(b[0], k - 1);
        b[1] = calc((int) (k - 1), (int) k);
        c[1] = Matrix.matpow(b[1], k - 1);

        Matrix s = Matrix.unit((int) (2 * k + 1));
        for (int j = 2; j < size; j++) {
            int idx = (int) (k - (j % k));
            b[j] = calc(idx, (int) k);
            s = s.multiply(c[j - 1]);
            b[j] = b[j].multiply(s);
            c[j] = Matrix.matpow(b[j], k - 1);
        }

        int idx = 1;
        long rem = n % k;
        n -= rem;
        int q = 0;
        tmp = n;
        if (tmp > 0) {
            while (tmp % k == 0) {
                ++q;
                tmp /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int) ((k - (q % k)) % k);

        Matrix ans = Matrix.unit((int) (2 * k + 1));
        ans = Matrix.matpow(a[q], rem).multiply(Matrix.matpow(a[(int) (q + k)], Math.max(rem - q, 0)));
        n /= k;
        if (n == 0) {
            return (ans.get((int) (2 * k), 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        --n;
        while (n > 0) {
            long t = n % k;
            if (t != 0) {
                ans = ans.multiply(Matrix.matpow(b[idx], t));
            }
            n /= k;
            ++idx;
        }
        ans = ans.multiply(b[1]);
        return (ans.get((int) (2 * k), 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        int size = (int) (2 * k + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(size);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                a[i].set(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * k - 1; j++) {
                a[i].set(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            a[i].set((int) (2 * k), 0, 1);
            a[i].set((int) (2 * k), (int) (2 * k), 1);
        }
        System.out.println(solve(n, k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
